title: Account access and login problems
applies_when: user cannot log in, password rejected, account locked out, or two-factor (2FA) codes not working.
resolution: Reset account credentials and confirmed successful login.

title: Billing and invoice problems
applies_when: user was charged incorrectly or twice, invoice is wrong, or a plan change was billed incorrectly.
resolution: Adjusted the invoice and issued a refund where applicable.

title: Product bugs
applies_when: the product shows an error, crashes, or fails to save changes.
resolution: Patched the bug and deployed a fix to production.

title: Feature requests
applies_when: user asks for a new capability, more customization, or support for something not yet available.
resolution: Captured the request and added it to the product backlog.

title: How-to and configuration questions
applies_when: user asks how to set up, configure, or export something and needs instructions.
resolution: Provided step-by-step instructions and relevant documentation.

title: General questions
applies_when: general account or workspace questions that don't fit another category.
resolution: Provided general guidance and confirmed the issue was resolved.

title: Performance degradation
applies_when: the product or API is slow, requests time out, or performance is degraded.
resolution: Optimized queries and increased resource allocation.

title: Security concerns
applies_when: suspicious login activity, unrecognized devices, a possible vulnerability, or a security compliance question.
resolution: Investigated logs, mitigated the issue, and updated security settings.
